newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Otter Gold says has 49 percent of Allstate.
newsitem.headline: Otter Gold says has 49 percent of Allstate.

text.p: Otter Gold Mines Group said on Tuesday it had moved to more than 49 percent ownership of Allstate Explorations NL, the major participant and manager of the Beaconsfield Mine project in Tasmania, Australia.

Otter said its net equity interest in the project had increased to 31 percent from 19 percent following Allstate's acquisition on May 30 of a 22 percent interest in the project previously held by Golden Shamrock Mines.
Allstate holds a 62.18 percent interest in the project, subject to pre-emption rights held by the Beaconsfield Gold Group.
"If the rights are exercised, Beaconsfield will be obliged to pay cash to Allstate to acquire a 10.67 percent interest," Otter said.
"Even should that occur, Allstate will remain as manager having a 51.51 percent interest and Otter will hold at least a 25 percent net equity interest in the project."

Late last week, Allstate announced drilling results for the Beaconsfield Mine project. Otter said the results were in line with expectations and continued to indicate that the project would be one of the more profitable and productive underground resources in Australia.
